title: Junior Interior Designer
description:
**Organization Description:**
Jaipur Rugs is a social enterprise that connects rural craftsmanship with global markets through its luxurious handmade carpets. It is a family-run business that offers an exclusive range of hand-knotted and hand-woven rugs made using 2500 years old traditional art forms. The founder, Mr. Nand Kishore Chaudhary created a unique business model, which provides livelihood to the artisans at their doorstep. This changed the standard practice of involving middlemen to work with artisanal communities. The company currently has a network of over 40,000 artisans spread across 600 rural Indian villages in five states of India. It has an end-to-end business model, right from sourcing of wool to exporting a finished handmade rug.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Attend walk-in customers and understand their design and furnishing requirements
* Provide product recommendations based on customer preferences, space planning, and interior aesthetics
* Assist customers in selecting rugs, home décor, furniture, and related products
* Prepare design presentations, mood boards, and product suggestions when required
* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, architects, and interior designers
* Conduct follow-ups with prospective customers and convert inquiries into sales
* Maintain showroom displays and ensure products are presented attractively
* Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, delivery, and customer support
* Stay updated on interior design trends, materials, colors, and market development
* Handle customer queries and provide excellent after-sales support

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong design sensibility and creativity
* .Excellent knowledge of space planning and aesthetics.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Photoshop, V-Ray, 3D Max, or similar design software.
* Good understanding of materials, furniture, lighting, and finishes.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to handle client interactions professionally.
* Good project coordination and vendor management skills.
* Strong problem-solving and time management abilities.
* Attention to detail and execution excellence.

title: AVP - UI/UX
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
Industry: Software Development
  
  
Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  
  
Experience: 10+ yrs
  
  
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. We are looking for an experienced and technically strong
**AVP – UI/UX & Full Stack Engineering**
to lead frontend engineering, user interface development, and full-stack application delivery. The role combines
**technical leadership, software architecture, user experience, and hands-on development**
to build scalable, responsive, and high-performance web applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in
**React.js, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS**
, along with experience in backend development, API integration, and interactive data visualisation. This role requires a technology leader who can guide engineering teams, make architectural decisions, and deliver intuitive digital experiences across devices and platforms.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Lead and mentor UI/UX and full-stack engineering teams, fostering collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement
* Define and implement scalable software architecture for high-performance web applications and advanced visualisation products
* Design, develop, and maintain responsive, reusable, and accessible user interfaces using React.js, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3
* Translate wireframes, design specifications, and user requirements into functional, interactive, and production-ready applications
* Establish frontend coding standards, reusable component libraries, and best practices for maintainable application development
* Collaborate with Product, UX/UI Design, Backend, and QA teams to deliver seamless end-to-end digital experiences
* Contribute to full-stack development, including backend services, API development and integration, and database connectivity
* Build interactive visualisations and data-rich interfaces using technologies such as D3.js and other suitable visualisation libraries
* Integrate mapping APIs and geospatial technologies, including Google Maps and OpenStreetMap, where required
* Optimise application speed, responsiveness, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility across high-performance desktops and lower-end mobile devices
* Assess existing systems to identify architectural limitations, technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for modernisation
* Drive technical design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, and implementation quality across engineering projects
* Apply Agile software development practices to manage delivery, resolve technical challenges, and ensure timely execution
* Coach team members, encourage knowledge sharing, and support professional development
* Evaluate emerging frameworks, libraries, and technologies to improve engineering productivity and user experience

What Makes You a Great Fit
  
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in frontend engineering, full-stack development, UI engineering, or software architecture, including significant technical or team leadership experience
* Strong hands-on expertise in React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
* Proven experience building responsive, high-performance, cross-browser web applications
* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, design systems, component architecture, accessibility, and usability
* Experience with frontend frameworks, MVC architectures, and libraries such as Angular or React
* Hands-on experience with backend development, RESTful APIs, integrations, and databases
* Experience with interactive data visualisation tools such as D3.js and mapping platforms such as Google Maps or OpenStreetMap is an advantage
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, performance optimisation, scalability, and maintainable coding practices
* Proven ability to lead large-scale engineering projects and collaborate across multiple teams
* Experience working in Agile environments and managing the software development lifecycle
* Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and stakeholder-management skills
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, establish technical standards, and drive continuous improvement
* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred

title: Senior Architect / Interior Designer / Project Manager - Healthcare
description:
Hospertz India Pvt Ltd is a Mumbai-headquartered healthcare-infrastructure company founded by a doctor. We plan, design and execute hospitals and clinics across India, from feasibility and architecture to interiors, MEP coordination and NABH-ready handover. Offices: Andheri (Mumbai), Bhopal and Chhattisgarh.

We are building our senior delivery team and hiring for three leadership roles, for people who have run large projects and large site teams.

1) SENIOR ARCHITECT - HEALTHCARE PROJECTS (2 openings)

• Lead hospital and clinic projects from concept and space programming to working drawings and site handover.

• Plan OT complexes, ICUs, wards, OPDs and diagnostics with correct zoning, flows and NABH requirements.

• Own complete AutoCAD drawing sets; coordinate MEP, structural and interior consultants.

• B.Arch with valid Council of Architecture registration; 7+ years including site execution.

2) SENIOR INTERIOR DESIGNER - HOSPITALS & LARGE COMMERCIAL PROJECTS

• Lead interiors for hospitals, clinics and diagnostic centres: concept, 3D, working drawings, finish schedules and BOQs.

• Drive site execution with contractors and vendors to quality and timeline.

• Degree/diploma in Interior Design; 6+ years with executed large projects; AutoCAD plus SketchUp/3ds Max.

3) SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER / SENIOR PROJECT COORDINATOR - MULTIPLE LARGE PROJECTS

• Run several large projects at the same time from mobilisation to handover: schedules, budgets, contractors, quality and safety.

• Lead and coordinate site teams of 30-50+ people (engineers, supervisors, contractors and vendors) across sites.

• Coordinate architects, interior designers, MEP and biomedical teams; report progress to clients and management.

• B.E./B.Tech Civil, B.Arch or equivalent; 8+ years on big-ticket construction or fit-out projects.

COMMON TO ALL THREE ROLES

• Proven experience on big projects and leading large teams (30-50 people) across multiple sites.

• Healthcare / hospital execution background is strongly preferred. Industrial, commercial or large residential execution is also considered.

• AutoCAD-based drawing workflow (our team standard).

• Based in or willing to relocate to Mumbai; travel to project sites across India.

Salary: Competitive, based on experience and team size handled.

How to apply: Apply here on LinkedIn, or email your CV to hospertzcareers@gmail.com with the subject "Role - Your name". Please mention the largest project and team size you have handled. Shortlisted candidates are contacted within 24 hours.

title: Senior Web Designer
description:
**What's the role?**
As our Web Graphic Designer, you'll play a key role in shaping how audiences experience HERE online. You'll transform complex technology topics into compelling visual stories while ensuring all website graphics remain accessible, consistent, scalable, and aligned with our brand and design system.
  
  

* Create and deliver digital graphics across HERE.com and the broader HERE website ecosystem to support launches, campaigns, and content refreshes.
* Translate complex technology concepts into engaging visual assets that support audience needs and business objectives.
* Partner closely with Content, UX, UI Design, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, and Development teams to create impactful digital experiences.
* Prepare, optimize, and export assets for web and email channels.
* Manage incoming design requests through Workfront, ensuring accurate updates and timely delivery.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of reusable visual assets within our Brand Folder and design libraries.
* Support content publishing workflows, including organizing and uploading approved assets through content management systems.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, agency partners, and subject matter experts to ensure quality, consistency, and strong design execution.
* Participate in sprint-based workflows and help deliver a continuous stream of high-quality content experiences.
* Support creative reviews by presenting design rationale and helping stakeholders align on final solutions.

**Who are you?**
You are a creative and collaborative designer who enjoys transforming complex topics into intuitive visual experiences. You combine strong design fundamentals with digital marketing expertise and can effectively communicate the thinking behind your work.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will likely bring:
  
  

* 4+ Years of experience creating web graphics, digital campaigns, and visual content for technology, SaaS, or B2B marketing environments.
* Strong proficiency with modern design tools and digital asset creation workflows.
* Experience developing accessible, brand-consistent visual content for websites and digital channels.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into engaging graphics, illustrations, iconography, and visual storytelling assets.
* Familiarity with design systems and brand governance frameworks.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including UX, UI Design, Content, Marketing, and Development stakeholders.
* Understanding of digital content production and optimization for web and email experiences.
* Experience using a content management system, preferably Contentful, to publish digital assets.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Experience contributing to storyboards and video concepts is beneficial, as is experience creating 3D design assets.

**What We Offer**
HERE offers an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge technology environment with challenging problems to solve! You can make a direct impact on delivery of company´s strategic goals and the freedom to decide how to perform your work. We will support you in delivering your day-to-day tasks and achieving your personal goals and developing your skills. Personal development is highly encouraged at HERE. You can take different courses and training at our online Learning Campus and join cross-functional team projects within our Talent Platform.
  
  
HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
**Who are we?**
HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.
  
  
At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.
  
  
You will join our multi-disciplinary Web Experience team, collaborating with colleagues based in Mumbai, Berlin, and Chicago. Together, we strategically and operationally manage HERE's ecosystem of websites, with HERE.com serving as the primary destination for inspiring and educating audiences, generating demand, and supporting self-service journeys through our products and documentation. As part of the Global Marketing function, you'll work alongside experts in Content, UX, UI Design, and Infrastructure to create engaging digital experiences that help customers understand and adopt HERE's technology solutions.

title: Visual Designer
description:
**Company Description**
iLabkart Technologies Pvt Ltd is a premier B2B distributor focused on building a reliable supply chain for the healthcare and commercial fitness industries across India. Founded by experts in healthcare and B2B sales, the company emphasizes integrity, quality, and innovation in all partnerships. iLabkart supplies certified medical diagnostics, reagents, and laboratory equipment to hospitals, clinical laboratories, and research institutions, as well as high-performance fitness and body composition equipment to gyms and corporate wellness centers. The organization is committed to stringent quality assurance, transparent business practices, and customer-centric support to streamline and enhance client workflows. Its vision is to be India’s preferred healthcare and fitness partner, enabling professionals to deliver better patient care and client results through a trusted, innovative supply network.

**Role Description**
The Visual Designer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. The Visual Designer will create and refine visual assets for digital and print materials, including marketing collateral, presentations, social media graphics, and web interfaces that support iLabkart’s healthcare and fitness B2B offerings. Responsibilities include developing and maintaining consistent branding across touchpoints, collaborating with marketing, sales, and product teams to translate business goals into clear visual communication, and preparing design files for production and deployment. The role involves designing user-friendly layouts for web and digital platforms, creating graphics that communicate complex information simply, and iterating designs based on stakeholder feedback and performance data. The Visual Designer will also contribute to design guidelines and templates to ensure visual consistency and efficiency across projects.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in Visual Design and Graphic Design, with the ability to create clear, engaging, and professional visuals including but not limited to presentations, manuals, socaial media posts, emailers for B2B audiences.
* Experience in Branding and Graphics, including developing and maintaining brand identity, style guides, and consistent visual language.
* Proficiency in Web Design, with an understanding of layout, typography, and responsive design for digital platforms.
* Advanced knowledge of industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, or similar) and file preparation for print and digital use.
* Relevant academic background in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple projects, and comfort working closely with cross-functional teams on-site.
* Portfolio demonstrating visual design work for corporate, healthcare, or technology sectors; B2B or healthcare/fitness domain experience is an advantage.
* Good communication skills and the ability to present and justify design decisions to stakeholders.

title: Graphic & Motion Graphic Designer
description:

**Company:**
Ignitic Ideas Pvt. Ltd.

**Website:**
www.igniticideas.in

**Location:**
Wagle Industrial Estate, Thane West, Maharashtra

**Experience:**
2–4 Years

**Joining:**
Immediate

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, Permanent

**Industry:**
Advertising, Branding & Digital Marketing (Real Estate Experience Preferred)

About Ignitic Ideas

Ignitic Ideas Pvt. Ltd. is a creative branding, digital marketing, and AdTech company specialising in innovative brand experiences, performance-driven campaigns, and technology-enabled advertising solutions. We work with clients across industries, with a strong focus on real estate marketing.

We are looking for a
**Graphic & Motion Graphic Designer**
who combines strong visual design skills with video editing, animation, and motion graphics expertise. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently transforming creative briefs into high-quality static creatives, engaging videos, and compelling visual content for brands, advertising campaigns, and digital platforms.

* Create high-quality static creatives for social media, digital advertisements, websites, banners, brochures, presentations, and other marketing materials.
* Design engaging social media posts, carousels, campaign creatives, and brand communication assets.
* Develop creative concepts and translate briefs into visually appealing designs aligned with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
* Work on branding materials, logo design, layouts, typography, and visual compositions.
* Edit, retouch, and enhance images to maintain professional visual quality.
* Ensure consistency in branding, colour palettes, typography, and visual identity across platforms.

2. Motion Graphics, Animation & Video Editing

* Create engaging motion graphics, 2D animations, reels, promotional videos, and short-form video content.
* Develop AI-generated videos, AI-based visual content, and seamless transition videos using suitable tools and techniques.
* Edit videos with effective pacing, transitions, effects, and beat synchronization to match music and audio.
* Apply visual storytelling, typography, animation, and composition techniques to create compelling video content.
* Produce video creatives for digital advertising campaigns, social media platforms, and client requirements.
* Work with audio, footage, graphics, and other visual elements to deliver polished final outputs.

3. Creative Execution & Collaboration

* Take ownership of creative assignments from concept development to final delivery.
* Collaborate with the creative, content, client servicing, and digital marketing teams to develop effective campaign assets.
* Adapt designs and videos to different platform specifications, formats, and campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Stay updated with emerging design trends, motion graphics techniques, AI creative tools, and industry best practices.
* Incorporate feedback and make revisions while maintaining creative quality and brand consistency.

Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in graphic design, motion graphics, and video editing.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Illustrator**
  .
* Strong understanding of graphic design fundamentals, including typography, colour theory, composition, layout, and visual hierarchy.

title: Digital Designer
description:
**About Trilliad**
Trilliad, a market-leading Growth Services Provider (GSP), solves challenges and drives results for Growth Leaders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Trilliad's full-service solutions deliver competitive advantage for the brands it works with by optimizing their sales and marketing strategies, processes, skills, and technology. Trilliad drives efficiency and predictability at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to increase seller productivity, lower cost per lead, decrease cost per sale, accelerate time to close, and drive customer lifetime value.
  
  
At Trilliad, culture is our backbone. It shapes how we think, behave, and treat one another, and it defines how our clients, partners, and communities experience us. Every company has a culture, and at Trilliad, we make ours intentional—anchored in our Leadership Principles. These principles guide every decision and interaction: putting the company first, obsessing over growth, remembering that business is personal, and ensuring strategy turns into execution. We succeed by being one team, striving for greatness, speaking the truth, and holding ourselves accountable. We lighten up with humor, stay patient and disciplined, run towards problems, celebrate results, and never accept confusion as an option. This is the culture you step into at Trilliad—purposeful, lived, and continually developed.
  
  
**What you will do**
You are accountable for the creative quality and in-market performance of the visual work Trilliad produces for Marketing-as-a-Service clients. You translate strategy, messaging, and narrative into visual systems that earn attention and move people to act, owning the idea rather than only its execution. This is not a production role: you bring a point of view about how a campaign should look, feel, and behave, and you make the case for it in reasoning a strategist and a client can follow. You own the work end to end, from concept through to files that are ready to run, built to clear approval, and designed for the real constraints of the channels they live in.
  
  
**Which means that on a day-to-day basis, you will:**
**Creative Direction and Concepting**

* Offer creative direction for campaigns and digital experiences across assigned client engagements
* Design creative concepts for ads, landing pages, social, email, and campaign assets that begin from the strategy rather than the format
* Shape visual narrative and layout around copy flow so that clarity and momentum survive contact with the page
* Recommend creative approaches to strategists and client teams, making the case for an idea rather than presenting options without a view

**Digital Asset Design and Production**

* Design production-ready digital assets including landing pages, emails, ebooks, sell sheets, ads, and social content
* Design light-motion and dynamic elements such as simple animations, social loops, and micro-interactions
* Drive consistency of visual system, typography, and brand expression across every asset in a campaign
* Lead work from concept through to delivery of files built to run correctly in the channels they are destined for

**Build, Implementation, and Technical Craft**

* Design and build landing pages using templates or modular components in WordPress or HubSpot
* Shape design intent through direct HTML and CSS adjustment in emails and landing pages so that what ships matches what was designed
* Guide developers through design-to-build translation on complex builds, owning simpler executions end to end
* Recommend design decisions that account for approval requirements, delivery specifications, and platform constraints before they become rework

**Performance, Iteration, and Improvement**

* Drive iteration on creative in response to performance data, client feedback, and delivery timelines
* Recommend creative change where performance indicates the current approach is not working, rather than defending the original execution
* Shape the reusable components, templates, and patterns that make future campaigns faster to produce without becoming generic

**How you'll do it**
Because how we do things matters just as much as what we do at Trilliad, our Leadership Principles should act as a compass directing the everyday behavior of every teammate across the organization:
  
  
**Growth Obsessed.**
For our business, our clients, and our Selves.
  
  
**Create Client Value.**
Become irreplaceable
  
  
**Business is Personal.**
Cultivate relationships. Make space for connection. Care about each other.
  
  
**Tighten-Up.**
Focus, discipline, and rigor count.
  
  
**Lighten-Up.**
Humor and laughter deepen bonds.
  
  
**Strategy Without Execution Is Just Dreaming.**
Hope is not a strategy. Vision matters—so does execution.
  
  
**You Have the Ball.**
Be accountable. Take action. Go the distance.
  
  
**Be One Team.**
No lone wolves. Have each other's back and help each other out.
  
  
**Run Towards Problems.**
Symptoms signal deeper causes. Find the root.
  
  
**Raise The Bar.**
Good is the enemy of great. Better never stops—be a Difference-Maker!
  
  
**Have the Hard Conversation.**
Be direct
*and*
empathetic. Speak the truth, kindly. Feedback is a gift.
  
  
**Confusion Is a Choice.**
Stay curious—Seek to understand. Share context—seek to be understood.
  
  
**Celebrate Results.**
Make recognition a habit. Shine a light on what's working, big or small.
  
  
**The Journey Matters.**
Meaningful work takes time. Be patient. Think: the next 90 days and the next 10 years.
  
  
**Think "We" not "Me."**
Prioritize what's best for the business, the team, and the journey.
  
  
  
  
  
  
**What You'll Bring – Skills, Knowledge, and Experience**
All Difference-Makers are expected to meet the Trilliad Standard for Transferable Skills and Knowledge, which defines the core capabilities every teammate must bring—regardless of role, function, or level.
  
  
**Trilliad transferable skills**
**Trilliad transferable knowledge**

* Contextual Awareness
* Critical Reasoning and Thinking
* Data/Analytic Acumen
* Empathy
* Judgment and Discernment
* Moral Courage
* Pattern Recognition and Systems Thinking
* AI Literacy
* Responsible and Effective AI Use
* Trilliad's Business and Commercial Context

The following domain-specific Skills, Knowledge, and Experience are additionally required in order for you to be great in this role.
  
  
**Domain-specific skills**

* Visual design and typographic craft — You are answerable for how the work looks, which at this level means composition, type, color, and hierarchy decisions that hold up across every format rather than only in the deck where they were presented
* Creative concepting from strategy — You generate the idea and not only the artwork, which requires you to start from the client's objective and the strategist's thinking rather than from a reference you admired
* Visual storytelling and narrative construction — You shape how a message unfolds across a page, a sequence, or a campaign so that a reader arrives at the point rather than simply being told it
* Adobe Creative Suite and Figma — You work daily in Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, and Figma, and must be fluent enough that tooling never becomes the limit on the idea
* Motion and dynamic content design — You produce simple animations, social loops, and micro-interactions, because static assets alone no longer hold attention in the channels these campaigns run in
* Front-end craft in HTML and CSS — You make direct adjustments in email and landing page code so that design intent survives implementation rather than degrading in handoff
* CMS page building in WordPress and HubSpot — You assemble landing pages from templates and modular components, which requires you to design within the system's real constraints instead of around them
* Conversion-focused digital design — You design assets whose job is to produce a click, a form completion, or a meeting, and must make creative choices that serve that outcome even when a more beautiful option exists
* Creative feedback and iteration — You absorb input from clients, strategists, and performance data without losing the integrity of the idea, and must judge which changes to accept and which to argue

**Domain-Specific Knowledge**

* Digital-first design principles and conversion-focused UX patterns — You must know the patterns that reliably move people through a page so that your layouts serve performance rather than aesthetics alone
* Layout, typography, color, and visual hierarchy — You need command of the fundamentals because at this level your judgment sets the standard that others work to
* Digital advertising specifications and platform guidelines — You must understand what each channel will accept and how creative decisions affect approval, delivery, and performance, so that work does not fail at the point of trafficking
* CMS architecture and design implementation — You need to understand how designs are built in WordPress, HubSpot, and comparable environments so that what you design can actually be made
* Email design and rendering constraints — You must know how email clients render layout and code so that assets behave predictably across the inboxes they land in
* Accessibility and responsive design standards — You need to understand contrast, structure, and adaptive layout requirements so that the work is usable across devices and abilities rather than only on your own screen
* B2B marketing and campaign structure — You must understand how B2B campaigns are constructed and what they are built to achieve so that your creative decisions are commercially grounded
* Brand and design system governance — You need to know how brand and component systems are built and maintained so that consistency scales without every asset requiring your personal involvement

**Domain-specific experience**

* 4+ years in digital design, art direction, or a comparable creative role, including ownership of campaign-level creative rather than individual assets alone
* A portfolio demonstrating original creative direction and visual thinking in a B2B context, including work you conceived rather than executed to another's direction

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Graphic Designer | LightYears Health | Lower Parel, Mumbai (In-office)**

**WHO WE ARE**

LightYears Health is on a mission to redefine how India ages, not with fear, but with science. We make clinically validated nutrition products for people who refuse to slow down: the 55-year-old who still lifts, the woman navigating menopause on her own terms, the 70-year-old who outruns her grandchildren.

We're not a supplement company. We're a preventive health company, building evidence-backed wellness products across arthritis, pain management, and hormonal health. And we're just getting started.

Our R&D team includes PhDs from IIT Delhi and Jamia Hamdard University. Incubated at MIT Sloan. Grounded in science, built on trust, powered by hustle.

15 months in market. 10x sales growth in the last 6 months. Now we're building the team for the next leap.

**VALUES THAT MATTER TO US**

- Question the status quo: we question the way things are done and encourage people to try new ways of doing things, as long as the risks are calculated.

- Transparency: we believe in an environment of complete, radical transparency. There are no wrong questions.

- Go-getter spirit: we're dealing with big problems and competitors with deep pockets. You're joining a team that solves difficult problems with creativity and hustle.

- Obsessed with consumer pain points: we're fixated on serving our consumers and keeping their needs before all else.

- Be nimble & get your hands dirty: at our stage of growth, agility is essential. Everyone, at every level, gets their hands dirty to get work done.

**THE ROLE**

TL;DR: you'll shape how LightYears looks, feels and is remembered. Working closely with our founder and brand team, you'll turn science-backed products into a visual identity people trust at first glance, from the illustration on a pack to the ad that stops a thumb mid-scroll and the product page that closes the sale. Illustration is a core skill for this role.

- Brand building: be a custodian of the LightYears visual identity. Evolve our design system (colour, typography, iconography, illustration style) and make every touchpoint feel unmistakably LightYears. Contribute ideas to brand campaigns, not just execute them.

- Illustration: create original illustrations that become a signature of the brand, across packaging, social media, website and campaigns. Develop and document a consistent illustration style.

- Packaging design: conceptualise and design packaging for new launches and variants, end to end. Create packs that stand out on a shelf and on a marketplace thumbnail, and work with vendors on materials, finishes and print-ready files.

- Social media design: design scroll-stopping carousels, statics and story assets. Turn copy and complex health science into visuals that are simple, warm and instantly clear.

- Performance marketing ads: design static ad creatives for Meta and Google every creative cycle with our performance marketing team. Build variations to test hooks, offers and formats, and use performance data to sharpen what you design next.

- Website banners & landing pages: design homepage banners, landing page sections and campaign assets for lightyearshealth.com that communicate clearly and support conversions.

- Marketplace PDPs: design product listing images, infographics and A+ content for Amazon, Flipkart and quick-commerce platforms. Decide what matters most to a shopper and make it impossible to miss.

- Cross-functional collaboration: work hand in hand with our content, video, performance marketing and product teams so every piece of creative feels cohesive and high-impact.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

- Bachelor's degree, with a focus on graphic design, visual communication or fine arts.

- 3+ years of experience in graphic design, preferably for a consumer brand.

- Strong illustration skills (required), with a portfolio showing original illustration work. Proficiency in Procreate.

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Experience designing packaging, from concept to print-ready files, is strongly preferred.

**TRAITS WE VALUE**

- A brand thinker: you don't just make things look good; you ask what they should make people feel, and can explain why a design choice is right for the brand.

- Creative thinking: we're solving big, fuzzy problems and want unconventional thinkers to help solve them.

- Hustler: you bring a go-getter mentality to the goals you set.

- A keen learner: a young company means steep learning curves, and you embrace them.

- Agility and adaptability: you adapt to changing consumer behaviour, trends and product strategies, whether that means picking up an AI design tool or turning around a quick static on a tight deadline.

- An interest in health and fitness: an interest in nutrition, longevity and healthy ageing is preferred (though not required).

**ROLE LOGISTICS**

- Full-time, in-person role at our office in Lower Parel, Mumbai.

- Monday to Friday, all five days in office, 9-hour work day (10:00 am – 7:00 pm).

- Compensation details will be disclosed after the first-round interview.

**INTERESTED? TAKE THE LEAP!**

Email your resume, your portfolio (with illustration work included) and a brief paragraph on why you're a good fit to talent@elevateconsumer.com. We're not considering applications without all three. Selected candidates will be contacted for an in-person interview.

Questions? Write to us at talent@elevateconsumer.com.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
**About Revun**
 Revun is building a next\-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
   

  

 The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
   

  

 Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
   

  

 The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Revun is hiring a
 **Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)** 
 to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
   

  

 This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi\-user systems.
   

  

 You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
   

  

 The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
   

  

 You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Please submit your
 **resume and portfolio** 
 for consideration.
   

  

 Your portfolio should include examples of real product\-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
   

  

 Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
   

  

 Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre\-recorded video interview 24\-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design user\-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace\-style platform
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high\-fidelity designs, and developer\-ready UI specifications
* Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
* Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
* Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
* Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
* Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
* Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
* Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
* Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
* Validate AI\-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
* Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent


**Required Experience**
* 6\+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
* Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi\-role software products
* Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
* Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role\-based user experiences
* Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
* Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
* Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user\-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
* Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer\-ready designs
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment


**Strongly Preferred Experience**
* Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi\-sided products
* Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field\-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
* Experience designing products with multiple user types and role\-based permissions
* Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service\-request, or dashboard workflows
* Experience designing AI\-powered product features or AI\-assisted workflows
* Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
* Experience working in startups or fast\-moving product environments
* Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
* Experience creating design systems from the ground up


 AI Expectations
   

  

 We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
   

  

**You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With**
* UX research organization
* User\-flow exploration
* Wireframe ideation
* Interface\-copy options
* Product requirement organization
* Edge\-case discovery
* Design\-system documentation
* Competitive research summaries
* Prototype concepts
* Usability\-test summaries
* Design iteration


 However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI\-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
   

  

 The Person We Are Looking For
   

  

 You are a true product thinker.
   

  

 You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
   

  

 You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
   

  

 You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.
   

  

 You think through edge cases, empty states, errors, mobile responsiveness, role\-based access, data\-heavy screens, and developer handoff.
   

  

 You are confident working with engineers and leadership, and you can explain why a design decision matters.
   

  

 You are also comfortable using AI to work faster, explore more options, and improve your process, while still owning the quality of the final product.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* The platform becomes easier to understand and easier to use
* Core workflows are redesigned with clearer user journeys
* Web and mobile experiences become more consistent and polished
* Developers receive clear, complete, buildable design specifications
* The design system becomes scalable and reusable
* Product screens feel modern, professional, and commercially ready
* Users can complete important tasks with less confusion and fewer unnecessary steps
* AI is used responsibly to improve speed, quality, and documentation
* Design work directly supports product launch and long\-term platform growth


**Compensation**
 The monthly compensation range for this role is:
   

  

 CAD $24,000–$36,000 annually
   

  

 Final compensation will depend on experience, product\-design depth, SaaS and marketplace experience, AI\-assisted workflow capability, communication skills, and ability to work independently.

title: User Experience Analyst
description:
**Role:** 
 UI/UX Analyst (D2C Product)
 



**Reports To:** 
 Lead D2C
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Work from Office)
 



  





**Nature of Business \& What You'll Own** 




 As UI/UX Analyst, you'll
 **diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data.** 




 You're not a pure designer. You're not a pure analyst. You're the
 **bridge** 
 – using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify
 *why* 
 customers drop off, and designing solutions to test.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Session recording analysis \- watch session recordings 2–3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns
2. UX friction diagnosis – combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements
3. A/B test variant design – sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy
4. Design system maintenance — collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website
5. Insight reporting – weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings
6. Tool evaluation – research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow



 You'll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user\-centric improvements across the platform.
 



  





**Technical Capabilities Required:** 




**Design Tools \& Prototyping:** 



* **Figma proficiency** 
 (non\-negotiable) – component\-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes
* Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering
* Understanding of mobile\-first design



**Analytics \& Data Tools( good to have):** 



* **GA4** 
 –funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool)
* **Session recording tools** 
 – session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification
* Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements
* Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters)



**Platform \& E\-Commerce Context:** 



* Familiarity of
 **e\-commerce platforms** 
 – enough to know what's possible and what's a technical constraint
* Familiarity with
 **conversion funnel** 
 – browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout → payment → confirmation



**Tools You Can Learn \& Suggest:** 



* You're encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow –
 **UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo** 
 , etc.
* You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools



  





**Functional Capabilities Required:** 




**Conversion Psychology:** 



* Understand micro\-interactions that drive decision\-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency)
* Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals)
* Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking – what job is the customer hiring this product for?



**UX Research \& Data Literacy:** 



* Can read a session recording and identify 3–5 UX issues
* Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas)
* Comfortable asking "why" – always validate assumptions with data before designing



**A/B Testing \& Iteration:** 



* Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork
* Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels)
* Iterate based on results – learn from losses, compound wins



**Communication \& Collaboration:** 



* Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early
* Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way
* Comfortable with ambiguity — you'll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* **2–3 years** 
 of UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e\-commerce, or D2C preferred)
* **Figma expertise** 
 \- can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency
* **Conversion psychology** 
 – understand how small UX changes impact user behavior
* **Data literacy** 
 – comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools
* **Mobile\-first thinking** 
 – design for phones first, then desktop
* **India D2C context** 
 – nice\-to\-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable
* **Written communication** 
 — can document findings clearly and present to non\-designers



  





**To apply , please complete the following 2 questions:** 




  





**Task 1 Description:** 




 Audit The Whole Truth Foods' website (thewholetruthfoods.com), specifically the
 **product browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout flow** 
 . Identify 4\-5 friction points or UX issues that could impact conversion rate. For 2 of these issues, design a proposed improvement in Figma or any free design tool (Penpot, Excalidraw, Figma free tier). Include a written analysis explaining:
 


* What friction you identified (and why it matters)
* How you'd measure the impact of your proposed change
* Hypothesis for what conversion lift you'd expect



  





**Task 2 Description:** 




 Your GA4 shows that 42% of users land on the homepage, but only 18% click into a category page. Of those who do, only 8% complete a purchase. Heatmap data shows the category navigation menu has low click\-through \- users instead using the search bar. Session recordings reveal users are confused about the difference between similar products (e.g., Whey Protein vs. Plant Protein, or different protein bar flavors). The exit rate on category pages is 35%."
 



**Candidate's Task:** 



1. **Diagnose the issue** 
 – Write 150–200 words on why category navigation is underperforming and how it impacts the funnel (consider: information overload, product differentiation, filtering options, trust signals)
2. **Propose 3 design/UX changes** 
 — Could include: improved category page layout, better filtering, comparison tools, simplified navigation, product badge/labeling, etc.
3. **Design 1 variant** 
 – Redesigned category page or navigation menu in Figma/free tool
4. **Testing \& insights plan** 
 – How would you test? What secondary metrics matter (e.g., time on category page, filter usage, comparison tool clicks)?

title: Visual Designer (Brand & Performance Creatives)
description:
**Visual Designer (Brand \& Performance Creatives) – Full\-time, On\-site, Mumbai** 




  





**About Ravel** 




 Ravel is a BSE\-listed, performance\-driven haircare brand. We don't run ad campaigns and hope. Every creative we ship is measured on ROAS, CAC, and thumb\-stop rate. If a static doesn't convert, we kill it and design a better one. That's the job.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will design the static ads that run our Meta account. Not brand posts, not moodboards, not one hero image a week. High\-volume, high\-quality ad creatives built for testing: multiple variations per concept, shipped fast, measured on real spend. Your design decisions get judged by CTR and ROAS, not by how they look in a portfolio. If you find that exciting, keep reading.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design static ads for Meta: product statics, offer creatives, review/testimonial ads, comparison formats, advertorial\-style images
* Produce variant grids, not single files: 3\-5 versions of every winning concept with different hooks, layouts, and visual anchors for structured A/B testing
* Turn copy and customer insights into scroll\-stopping visuals. The copywriter gives you the words; you make them impossible to scroll past
* Design for the feed, not the brand book: readable at thumbnail size, message visible in the first half second, offer never buried
* Read performance data on your own creatives (thumb\-stop rate, CTR) and iterate based on numbers, not taste
* Maintain speed: brief on Monday, creatives live by Wednesday, data by end of week
* Support adjacent needs when required: Amazon A\+ creatives, landing page sections, WhatsApp broadcast creatives



  





**Who Should Apply** 



* You've designed static ads that ran with real money behind them and you know how they performed
* You work fluently in Photoshop or Figma. Canva\-only won't survive the volume and precision this role needs
* You think in variations. Your instinct on a winning ad is "what are 4 more ways to say this," not "next project"
* You can defend every design choice with a conversion reason, not an aesthetic one
* You're comfortable being wrong fast. Half your creatives will fail. The winners will more than pay for them



  





**Why This Role** 



* Your work runs on meaningful budgets from day one, with full visibility into results
* Fast feedback loops: you'll know within days whether your creative won, and why
* You'll learn performance marketing from the inside, sitting next to media buying data most designers never see
* Competitive pay, with growth tied to the performance you drive



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume and portfolio to ayush@ravelcare.com with 3\-5 static ads that actually went live, one line each on the objective and result. Include at least one example of multiple variations of the same concept. Applications without live ad work won't be considered.

**The IDFC FIRST Bank Philosophy:** 




 IDFC FIRST Bank is a new\-age, Digital\-first bank, committed to transforming the way Indians experience banking. Our goal is to build a world\-class bank in India—one that is driven by ethics, powered by technology, and a force for social\-good. As a young and digital Bank, we are uniquely positioned to disrupt the sector and shape the future of banking for millions of Indians. We’re anything but traditional. We acknowledge that building effective digital experiences for fintechs requires a strong foundation of motion, 3D and storytelling. This makes motion design and animation critical in shaping our products and ensuring that they are not only functional but visually stunning, immersive and delightful. Come, let’s build a world\-class Bank with world\-class Motion and Illustration.
 



  





**About the job:** 




 As a Motion Experience Designer, you will be responsible for designing streamlined UX motion experiences for our app and generating high\-quality 3D artefacts such as icons, illustrations and motion graphics. You will work alongside our writers, illustrators and motion designers to complement their work with 3D and elevate our visual storytelling. You need to be a passionate, experienced, and detail\-oriented designer—someone who has a proven record of creating polished, immersive, and high\-performing motion and illustration content. You live and breathe motion and cinematography. You are comfortable both conceptualizing and executing motion design across digital platforms—often using AI to accelerate your workflow. You will collaborate closely with designers, developers, marketers, and product managers to ensure that visuals are both effective and delightful.
 



  





**What will you be responsible for:** 



* UX Motion Design
 
 : Create seamless and engaging motion experiences for app journeys, transitions, and micro\-interactions.
* 3D Artefact Creation
 
 : Design high\-quality 3D icons, banners, and illustrations that enhance the visual appeal of our products.
* Product Illustration
 
 : Collaborate with our 2D illustrator to extend and complement visual narratives across platforms.
* Dev Hand\-off and Motion Specs
 
 : In case of Lottie and Rive animations, create detailed motion specifications that will help front\-end developers implement the designs up to expectations.
* Creative Direction
 
 : Contribute to the visual direction and storytelling of digital experiences, ensuring consistency and brand alignment.
* Performance Awareness:
 
 Design visuals that are optimized for speed, accessibility, and user engagement.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 
 : Work closely with design, product, marketing, and development teams to align visuals with business goals and user needs.
* Quality Assurance
 
 : Conduct Creative QA of artefacts to ensure they are implemented with pixel\-perfection and as per specifications.
* Stay Up to date
 
 : Keep up with AI, design trends, tools, and best practices. Continuously improve and innovate our visual strategy.



  





**Therefore, you should have:** 



* Experience
 
 : 5\-7 years of experience in UX motion design, 3D illustration, or related roles, preferably in digital\-first creative agencies or B2C organizations.
* Tool Proficiency
 
 : Expertise in modern 3D and motion tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Houdini, Spline, After Effects, Lottie, Rive, and strong familiarity with AI tools like Midjourney, ChatGPT, Nano Banana, etc.
* Design Skills
 
 : Strong understanding of UX motion, animation principles, product illustration, and visual storytelling.
* Technical Awareness
 
 : Ability to design within technical constraints such as video performance, webpage load times, and HTML compatibility.
* Collaboration Skills
 
 : Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Portfolio
 
 : A portfolio or showreel that showcases your best work and thinking process. If not, you might be asked to take a take\-home design challenge.


- 


  





**What would make you stand out:** 



* You’ve worked in financial services, fintech, or other complex, highly regulated industries and know how to balance creativity with compliance.
* Have led motion strategy for high\-performing apps or digital products.
* Have won awards in design or have a high follower\-count on your Behance, Dribbble, or professional Instagram account.
* Take interest in areas adjacent to design: architecture, branding, pop\-culture, photography, etc.
* Enjoy mentoring, reading, researching, writing articles, and working with the broader community of designers.
* Believe that design is more than just work, but a way of life. You love to animate, illustrate, experiment, and have a keen eye for motion and aesthetics



  





 Best of luck!

title: Business Designer
description:
TinkerLabs is a behavioural design firm in Mumbai. For over a decade, we've helped organisations understand people and design interventions that change what they do.
 



  





 We're good at the human side. We don't always ask early enough whether the business can carry it: what it costs, who pays, and whether it lasts.
 



  





 That's the gap this role fills, in our clients' work and in our own. The job has two halves.
 



  





**Outward** 
 , you'll be the business and feasibility voice inside deeply user\-focused work, on projects spanning sales transformation, customer insight, financial inclusion and public health.
 



  





**Inward** 
 , TinkerLabs will be your client too. We're in a growth phase with more doors open than we can walk through. You'll work alongside the founder to decide which ones matter. Then you'll build the systems, from how we sell to how we deliver, that let us walk through them without breaking.
 



  




**What you'll do** 

  





**On client work** 




**Be the viability voice.** 
 Sit inside behavioural research and design projects and hold the commercial question open: unit economics, cost to serve, market size, competitive dynamics, what the client's P\&L can actually absorb. Not as the final gate at the end. From the first week, alongside the researchers.
 



  





**Conduct real business research.** 
 Market and category analysis, competitor mapping, business model teardowns, secondary data, expert conversations. Our user research is strong. This is the other half of the picture, and we want it just as rigorous.
 



  





**Design the model, not just the solution.** 
 Value propositions, revenue models, pricing, go\-to\-market, service blueprints. Turn a good idea into something with a path to being real.
 



  





**Facilitate.** 
 Co\-creation sessions with clients, and workshops for corporate and academic audiences. You'll be in front of a room regularly.
 



  





**On TinkerLabs** 




**Look far, look near: help us choose where to grow.** 
 We have more avenues than capacity: new sectors, new clients, new offerings, new ways to package what we know. You'll work with the core team to size them, pressure\-test them and pick. Then you'll work out the how: what it takes, who does it, and in what order.
 



  





**Be systematic, like a mathematics professor.** 
 Treat the firm as a design problem. How does a lead become a proposal? How does a proposal become a priced, staffed project? How does that project run week to week and close well? Too much of our work lives in people's heads. You'll map how we actually work, find where it breaks, and redesign it.
 



  





**Build the pitch and the narrative.** 
 Approach notes, proposals, positioning. This includes the question every firm like ours is being asked right now: what does AI change about what we do, and where do we stand? We have a point of view forming. You'll help us sharpen it.
 



  





 The split between the two halves will shift. Some months will be mostly client work, others mostly internal.
 



  




 Who we need
 
  





 Our team has come from anthropology, psychology, design, engineering, architecture and business. Your background matters less than what it lets you do. That said, you should bring:
 



  





**3\+ years in the right kind of room.** 
 Strategy consulting, business design, product strategy, growth, venture building, corporate strategy or founder's office. An MBA is welcome, not required.
 



  





**Real commercial instinct.** 
 You can look at a business and quickly see how it makes money and where that breaks.
 



  





**Systems you've built that people actually used.** 
 Processes, pipelines, pricing models, project rhythms. Not decks about systems. Bonus if you did it inside a firm that was growing while you built it.
 



  





**The ability to turn a half\-formed question into a plan.** 
 A lot of the internal work will start as a hunch. You'll need to shape it, push back when it's the wrong question, and see it through.
 



  





**The ability to hold a room.** 
 From a CXO challenging your numbers to a client's frontline team wondering why you're there.
   




 What is in it for you (beside the core role)
 
  






 We don't stop at the deck. We find the behaviour, design the intervention, put it in the field, and stay until it works. You'll see the whole arc, from the first insight to whether it actually worked.
 




  





 We're small and growing fast. Whoever joins now shapes what we become.
 



  





 Here's what that means concretely.
 



**You'll design the firm, not just the projects.** 
 You'll decide which sectors we go after, how we sell, how we price and how we deliver, working directly with the core team.
 



  





**You'll get range you won't find anywhere else.** 
 We've worked with Microsoft, HUL, Flipkart, Swiggy, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Vodafone, The Oberoi Group, GAP and Raymond. We've also worked with PATH, UNFPA, GIZ, Population Council, Bloomberg Philanthropies and the Gates Foundation. Banking, retail, public health, technology, hospitality, gender, education. A sales transformation one month, financial inclusion for low\-income women the next.
 



  





**You'll have a seat at the centre of the work.** 
 You won't be handed insights to monetise. You'll be in the research, in the design, and in the pitch.
 



  





**You'll join a team that makes you better.** 
 Small, sharp, supportive, and serious about craft.
 



  




 How to apply
 
  





 Besides sharing your CV, please respond to two short prompts. We're interested in how you think, not how polished it looks.
 


1. Pick a product or service you think is genuinely well designed but commercially broken. What's wrong with the model, and what would you change?
2. AI is changing what clients will pay consultants for. Using real evidence, tell us what's losing value, what's gaining value, and where a firm like ours should stand.



  





 Answer in any format that does the thinking justice.
 



  





 Send your responses, updated CV and portfolio to curious@tinkerlabs.in with the subject line
 **Business Designer\_(Your name)** 
 .
 



  





*A human reads every application. You'll hear back from us either way.*

We combine creativity, technology, and storytelling—including generative AI workflows—to bring products and ideas to life and help our clients connect with their audiences in meaningful ways.

 **Mid\-Level Graphic Designer**

 **AI image generation** 
 to join our creative team and contribute to diverse and exciting projects.
   




 Job Description
 
 As a
 **Graphic Designer** 
 at Unstitched, you will play a key role in creating visually compelling designs and branding materials for leading Beauty, FMCG, Automotive, and Fashion brands.
 



 You will use traditional design tools alongside
 **generative AI platforms** 
 to develop original concepts, generate and refine visual assets, accelerate creative exploration, and build campaign\-ready imagery. You will collaborate with our 3D animators, creative directors, and marketing teams to produce high\-quality visuals aligned with our clients’ brand identities and project goals.
 



 Your work will span multiple industries, ensuring every design is innovative, on\-trend, and tailored to its target audience.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 * Create visually striking graphics and layouts for 3D product animations, social media, advertising campaigns, and other marketing materials.
* Use AI image\-generation tools to conceptualize, generate, iterate, and refine high\-quality visual assets.
* Write and optimize effective prompts to achieve specific styles, compositions, lighting, moods, and brand\-aligned results.
* Combine AI\-generated imagery with traditional design techniques, including compositing, retouching, typography, color correction, and image manipulation.
* Maintain visual consistency across AI\-generated assets and ensure outputs meet brand, quality, resolution, and production requirements.
* Collaborate with the creative team to conceptualize and execute design solutions for a wide range of projects.
* Develop brand\-aligned visuals, including logos, typography, color palettes, style frames, and mood boards.
* Create design assets for product animations and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Develop storyboards to visualize animation sequences, advertising concepts, and campaign narratives.
* Design engaging social media creatives, including static posts, carousels, and short animations.
* Experiment with emerging AI image and video tools, workflows, and techniques to improve creative quality and production efficiency.
* Evaluate AI\-generated outputs critically, identify visual inconsistencies or artifacts, and refine them into polished, professional assets.
* Ensure the responsible use of AI\-generated content, including compliance with applicable brand guidelines, licensing requirements, confidentiality obligations, and intellectual\-property considerations.
* Optimize designs for web, mobile, social media, and other digital platforms.
* Stay updated on design trends, generative AI developments, creative tools, and emerging production techniques.
* Work closely with clients and internal teams to understand project requirements and deliver designs that exceed expectations.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining consistently high standards.


 Requirements:
 
  





**Experience:** 



* 2–4 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in a creative studio or agency.
* Demonstrable experience using generative AI as part of a professional design workflow.
* A strong portfolio showcasing graphic design, storyboarding, branding, and AI\-generated or AI\-assisted visual work across different industries.



  





**Software and Technical Proficiency:** 



* Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.
* Hands\-on experience with AI image\-generation platforms such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, image\-to\-image workflows, inpainting, outpainting, style development, upscaling, and post\-production.
* Familiarity with AI video\-generation platforms such as Runway or comparable tools.
* Storyboarding tools.
* Figma or other prototyping tools.
* Ability to integrate AI\-generated assets into Photoshop and other production workflows to create polished, commercially usable designs.



  





**Creative and Professional Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, composition, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to maintain character, product, and stylistic consistency across AI\-generated images.
* Experience creating assets for social media and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong visual judgment and the ability to distinguish between raw AI output and production\-ready creative work.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating visually impactful designs.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously explore new AI tools and creative workflows.


 Nice\-to\-Have
 * Knowledge of motion graphics and video editing.
* Experience with AI video generation and AI\-assisted animation workflows.
* Experience training or working with custom AI models, LoRAs, ControlNet, or similar advanced image\-generation workflows.
* Experience working with 3D product animations.
* Familiarity with multiple industries and the ability to adapt designs to different sectors.
* Understanding of copyright, licensing, disclosure, and ethical considerations related to generative AI content.


 What We Offer
 * The opportunity to work on exciting, high\-profile projects across various industries.
* Access to emerging AI tools and the freedom to experiment with new creative workflows.
* A collaborative and creative work environment.
* Professional development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours.



  





  





 Join us at Unstitched and help us redefine visual storytelling through design, AI, CGI, and animation.
 



*Unstitched is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* 




  





**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.**

title: Instructional Designer & Digital Learning Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Instructional Designer \& Digital Learning Manager to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical maritime engineering, safety compliance, and cutting\-edge digital education. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying highly interactive, high\-retention digital learning modules. Your content will train both shore\-based corporate teams and seafarers deployed globally on our vessels.
   

  

 The ideal candidate understands how adult brains learn and can translate dense technical manuals or safety management systems (SMS) into modern, engaging digital formats optimized for low\-bandwidth and offline environments.
   

  

 We expect the person to be able to liaise with external vendors for quick content development and hence knowledge of industry practices is appreciated.
   

  

 The position is also expected to actively participate in upgrade of our existing Learning Management System and will be responsible for management of the same.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Content Design \& Development: Create interactive e\-learning modules, micro\-learning assets, video explainers, and simulation\-based courses using Articulate 360 (Storyline/Rise) and Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Technical Translation: Collaborate closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)—including Marine Superintendents, Chief Engineers, and Safety Managers—to convert complex maritime regulations (IMO, MARPOL), engineering blueprints, and operational workflows into clear training content.
* Low\-Bandwidth Optimization: Architect digital packages (SCORM) specifically designed and compressed for smooth deployment on onboard vessel networks and mobile devices with limited internet connectivity.
* Multimedia Production: Script, film, record, and edit high\-quality instructional videos, animations (using Vyond or After Effects), graphic assets, and audio narration.
* Assessment \& Evaluation: Design rigorous, scenario\-based evaluations that measure practical decision\-making and compliance competency, bridging digital learning with onboard physical drills.
* LMS Maintenance: Package and publish courses according to e\-learning standards, ensuring seamless tracking, scoring, and data synchronization with our centralized Crewing and HR systems.


**Requirements:**
* Experience: 3\+ years of experience in instructional design and digital content creation. Experience within maritime, logistics, heavy engineering, aviation, oil \& gas, or defense sectors is highly preferred.
* Instructional Design Mastery: Strong foundation in adult learning theories (ADDIE, SAM, Gagne’s Nine Events) with a proven ability to architect micro\-learning frameworks.
* Authoring Tools: Expert\-level proficiency in Articulate 360 (Storyline and Rise) or Adobe Captivate.
* Multimedia Skills: Hands\-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator) and animation software like Vyond.
* Deep understanding of LMS platforms and features
* Technical \& Spatial Literacy: Ability to read technical documentation, process flowcharts, and spatial layouts to build accurate procedural training.
* Project Management: Excellent consultative soft skills to interview busy SMEs, handle stakeholder feedback loops, and manage multiple course development timelines simultaneously.


**Additional Desired Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Corporate Training, or a related field.
* Familiarity with maritime safety frameworks (SMS) and seafaring competence standards.
* Experience implementing AI\-assisted tools for rapid storyboarding, voiceovers, or asset generation.


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

 **think, conceptualise and execute**

* Create high\-quality visual content for Instagram, LinkedIn and other digital platforms.

* Take feedback constructively and iterate quickly.
* Maintain consistency and quality across every piece of work.

**Strong design fundamentals are non\-negotiable.**

* 2–5 years of experience in graphic design, preferably in an agency, studio or fast\-paced creative environment.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to understand and interpret a brief.
* A willingness to experiment with
 **AI\-powered creative tools** 
 and learn new technologies.

 You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be
 **curious and comfortable experimenting with AI tools** 
 .

 We're particularly interested in designers who understand that AI isn't a replacement for design — it's another tool in the creative toolkit.
 



  





 The Ideal Person
 



 You are someone who:
 


* Notices bad kerning from across the room.
* Has a strong visual point of view.
* Doesn't rely entirely on Pinterest for ideas.
* Understands why something looks good, not just
 *that* 
 it looks good.
* Can take a vague idea and turn it into a strong visual concept.
* Is comfortable receiving feedback and defending a design when you believe in it.
* Keeps up with fashion, culture, advertising, design and social media.
* Is excited by variety and doesn't want to design the same thing every day.
* Wants to grow into a
 **creative thinker** 
 , not just an executor.



 What You'll Get
 


* The opportunity to work across exciting and diverse brands.
* Exposure to branding, social media, advertising, content production and AI.
* A highly creative, collaborative working environment.
* The opportunity to build campaigns and visual identities rather than only producing day\-to\-day social posts.
* Space to experiment and bring your own ideas to the table.
* The opportunity to grow within a young and ambitious creative studio.

 Please apply with your
 **portfolio**
