 We'd love to see:
 


* Social media work
* Branding projects
* Campaign concepts
* Typography/layout work
* AI\-assisted creative, if applicable
* Any personal projects that demonstrate your visual thinking

title: AI Graphic Designer
description:
**Who We Are:** 




 Cimpress is the world leader in mass customization. Through our technology, production, and supply chain capabilities, Cimpress businesses make it possible for customers around the world to personalize physical products and have them manufactured on demand with high quality, speed, reliability, and affordability.
 



 As a global, remote\-first organization, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and high\-performing workplace.
 



 About the Role:
 



 The Creative Automation Designer will be responsible for creating scalable, flexible, and production\-ready design solutions that can adapt across multiple products, formats, sizes, content variations, and customer requirements.
 



 The role combines strong visual design expertise with dynamic design systems, responsive layouts, auto\-layout, reusable components, AI\-powered creative workflows, and production knowledge.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to transform static creative concepts into intelligent, reusable, and scalable design solutions.
 



 You will collaborate closely with Creative Operations, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams to bridge creative design with technical implementation and help build efficient, future\-ready creative workflows.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**Dynamic \& Scalable Design** 



* Create visually compelling and production\-ready designs for print, packaging, promotional products, branding, and digital applications.
* Develop dynamic templates and scalable layouts that adapt across products, formats, sizes, content, and customer requirements.
* Transform static designs into flexible, reusable, and scalable design solutions by defining clear layout and content behavior rules.
* Identify opportunities to improve scalability by converting repetitive design activities into reusable templates, components, and workflows.



**Auto Layout \& Responsive Design** 



* Develop layouts using auto\-layout, responsive design, constraints, grids, and component\-based principles.
* Define how layouts respond to changes in content, text length, image dimensions, product sizes, and available space.
* Establish rules for resizing, reflow, stacking, wrapping, positioning, spacing, and content priority.
* Ensure designs maintain visual hierarchy, usability, consistency, and quality across digital, print, and product formats.



**Design Systems \& Component Libraries** 



* Create and maintain design systems, component libraries, templates, visual assets, and design standards.
* Develop reusable components for typography, color, imagery, icons, grids, spacing, and layouts.
* Establish design rules that support consistency, scalability, and reuse across products and business units.
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to translate design components and specifications into dynamic design systems and platforms.



**AI\-Powered Creative \& Automation** 



* Leverage Generative AI and AI\-powered creative tools for ideation, asset creation, variations, enhancement, retouching, and adaptation.
* Evaluate and refine AI\-generated outputs to ensure quality, accuracy, originality, and brand consistency.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI and automation into creative workflows to improve productivity, scalability, and quality.
* Experiment with emerging creative technologies and contribute to AI\-assisted workflows and best practices.



**Visual Design, Print \& Production** 



* Apply strong principles of typography, composition, visual hierarchy, color, grids, spacing, branding, and design consistency.
* Create designs that balance creative quality, scalability, usability, and production requirements.
* Apply knowledge of print production, packaging, substrates, dielines, color management, resolution, finishing, and manufacturing constraints.
* Ensure outputs are technically accurate and suitable for automated, personalized, and large\-scale production.



**Collaboration \& Implementation** 



* Collaborate with Creative, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams to understand requirements and deliver effective design solutions.
* Translate creative concepts into clear design rules, specifications, components, and implementation requirements.
* Partner with technical teams to ensure design intent is accurately translated into dynamic and scalable systems.
* Participate in design reviews, prototyping, experimentation, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.



**Quality \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Maintain high standards of visual quality, consistency, accuracy, scalability, and production readiness.
* Review dynamic templates and outputs to identify layout, typography, imagery, responsiveness, and production issues.
* Establish and follow quality standards for dynamic design and template production.
* Continuously identify opportunities for standardization, automation, AI adoption, and workflow optimization.



  





  





**Your Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, UI/UX, or a related field.
* **3–5\+** 
 years of professional experience in graphic, visual, template, dynamic, or production design.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating dynamic layouts, templates, responsive design, and production\-ready creative work.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, visual hierarchy, color, spacing, composition, grids, and brand consistency.
* Strong understanding of responsive layouts, auto\-layout, constraints, components, and reusable design patterns.
* Ability to translate designs into rules, logic, templates, and reusable components that can scale across formats, sizes, products, and customer requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.
* Experience creating adaptable layouts, templates, design variations, and reusable visual assets for print and digital applications.
* Practical experience with Generative AI and AI\-powered creative tools for ideation, image generation, variations, enhancement, retouching, and production acceleration.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated outputs and maintain quality, accuracy, brand consistency, and production standards.
* Willingness to continuously learn and adopt AI, automation, and emerging creative technologies.
* Understanding of how design systems and creative assets can support scalable and automated production workflows.
* Experience with Figma, Adobe Firefly, Canva, or other Generative AI tools will be an added advantage.
* Experience with design systems, component libraries, style guides, and automated creative workflows.
* Experience in e\-commerce, print, packaging, or high\-volume design operations.



  





  





**Why You'll Love Working Here:** 




 At Cimpress, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to scalable creative solutions that connect design, technology, automation, and AI.
 



 This role offers the opportunity to help shape efficient, future\-ready creative workflows while working across Creative, Product, Technology, Automation, and Business teams.
 



  





**We're Remote\-First:** 




 Cimpress operates with a Remote\-First culture that empowers employees with flexibility, autonomy, and trust.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 




 Cimpress is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. title: Structural Design Engineer (RCC)
description:
**Company Description** 




 Flood Precast, established in 1979, specializes in precast concrete products with a strong focus on precast concrete structures. Through continuous research and development, the company has expanded its capabilities and product range to serve diverse construction needs. Flood Flooring is now recognized as the largest producer of precast concrete flooring in the UK and Irish markets. The company is committed to quality, innovation, and reliable delivery, offering robust engineering solutions to support modern infrastructure projects.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This full\-time Structural Design Engineer (RCC) role at Flood Precast India is an on\-site position based in Mumbai. The role involves performing structural analysis and design of reinforced concrete components and precast systems for residential and commercial projects. The engineer will prepare detailed design calculations, drawings, and specifications, and ensure compliance with relevant codes and standards. Daily tasks include using tools such as AutoCAD and Tekla Structures/Tekla Structures Designer for modelling, detailing and analysis, coordinating with project managers, architects, and site teams, and reviewing designs for safety, durability, and constructability. The role also includes assisting in value engineering, supporting technical documentation, and contributing to continuous improvement of design processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Strong foundation in Structural Engineering and Civil Engineering, with the ability to design RCC and precast concrete elements.
* Proficiency in Structural Analysis using relevant software and methods to assess loads, stability, and performance.
* Structural Analysis \& Modelling: Develop and analyse structural models using appropriate software to evaluate load combinations, connections, and structural behaviour of precast systems.
* Knowledge of Eurocodes and standards applicable to RCC and precast structures.
* Ability to interpret architectural and structural drawings and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with attention to accuracy and detail.
* Relevant industry experience in building or infrastructure projects; precast concrete experience is an advantage.



  





  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




 •     
 
 M.Tech in Structural Engineering.
 




 •     
 
 Minimum 4 years of experience in RCC structural design with exposure to precast construction or in\- situ construction.
 




 •     
 
 Proficiency in Tekla Structures Designer and other design software.
 




 •     
 
 Strong knowledge of RCC design principles and seismic design.
 




 •     
 
 Good communication and coordination skills required; a strong hold on English will be an advantage.
 




  





**Preferred Skills** 




 •     
 
 Exposure to precast structures or BIM workflows.
 




 •     
 
 Familiarity with international codes (Eurocode / BS) is an advantage.
 




 •     
 
 Experience in a structural design consultancy environment.
 




  





**Salary** 



* **Salary:** 
 Highly competitive, above industry benchmarks — reflecting your expertise and experience in precast structural design.
* **Growth:** 
 Clear career progression path within a fast\-growing precast construction leader.
* **Work Environment:** 
 Opportunity to work on landmark precast projects with exposure to international design codes (Eurocode/BS) and modern BIM workflows.
